# rust-fetch

> Resilient HTTP, Server-Sent Events, and WebSocket client for JavaScript/TypeScript (`npm install rust-fetch`) and Rust (`rust-fetch` crate). Core request policy (URL resolution, validation, retries with jittered backoff, phase timeouts/deadlines, rate/concurrency limits, circuit breaking, SSRF checks, typed errors, interceptors) is compiled from Rust to WebAssembly so behaviour matches across browsers, Web Workers, Cloudflare Workers (`workerd`), Deno, Bun, and Node.js 20+. The package has zero runtime dependencies, no install scripts, and `sideEffects: ["./node.js", "./rust_fetch.js", "./snippets/*"]`.

Documentation: https://asemqaffaf.github.io/rust-fetch/ (guide, security, threat model, performance, transport conformance, API reference).

Use `rust-fetch` when you want `fetch()` plus consistent production policy (phase timeouts, logical deadlines, jittered retries, interceptors, streaming, typed errors, SSRF protection) in one client. Prefer `undici.request()` for maximum raw throughput in Node.js only, and native `fetch()` when bundle size matters most (`rust_fetch_bg.wasm` is ~148 KB brotli; the unminified browser entry `.wasm` + JS glue is ~171 KB brotli).

## Install and setup

```js
// npm install rust-fetch
// Node.js 20+: Wasm loads automatically on import (safe `await init()` no-op also works)
import { WasmClient } from 'rust-fetch';
// Unit testing mock transport (not in production bundles):
// import { createMockTransport } from 'rust-fetch/testing';

// Browsers, workers, and bundlers: call init() (or initSync()) once before creating a client
import init, { initSync, WasmClient as BrowserClient } from 'rust-fetch';
await init();                                    // fetches/compiles the .wasm (or await init({ module_or_path }))
// initSync({ module: compiledModuleOrBytes });  // sync form when WebAssembly.Module/bytes are already available
// Direct positional `init(input)` / `initSync(bytes)` forms are deprecated; prefer object arguments.

const client = new WasmClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com/v1', // relative URLs resolve under it; baseUrl query/fragment is rejected
  headers: { authorization: 'Bearer …' }, // plain object, Headers, Map, or [name, value][]
  timeoutMs: 10_000,                      // per attempt (including body); default 30000; 0 disables
  deadlineMs: 30_000,                     // total logical call deadline (queues, retries, backoff, body)
  retries: 3,                             // or RetryOptions object; off by default
  // retryBudget: true,                   // client-wide retry budget { ratio: 0.2, minPerSecond: 10, windowMs: 10000 }
});
```

- Subpath exports: `"."` (`node` → `./node.js`, `default` → `./rust_fetch.js`, types `./rust_fetch.d.ts`), `./rust_fetch.js`, `./testing` (`./testing.js`, `./testing.d.ts`), `./rust_fetch_bg.wasm`, `./package.json`.
- Resource cleanup: `WasmClient`, `EventStream`, and `WebSocketConnection` implement `.free()` and `[Symbol.dispose]()` (`using client = new WasmClient()`).
- Standalone helpers (without `WasmClient`): `fetch_json(url)`, `fetch_text(url)`, `fetch_with_options(url, method, headers, body?)`, `create_client()` (deprecated aliases: `fetch_json_promise`, `fetch_wasm_api`, `fetch_wasm_html`, `fetch_wasm_json`, `fetch_wasm_map`).

## Requests, bodies, responses, and redirects

- Methods: `client.get(url, options?)`, `head(url, options?)`, `delete(url, options?)`, `post(url, init?)`, `put(url, init?)`, `patch(url, init?)`, `fetch(url, init?)`, `post_json(url, body, options?)`, `put_json(url, body, options?)`, `patch_json(url, body, options?)`, `request(method, url, headers?, body?, options?)`. `TRACE` and `CONNECT` are rejected.
- `params`: plain object (`arrays` repeat keys, `null`/`undefined` skipped) or `URLSearchParams`.
- TypeScript: `client.get<User>('/users/42')` returns `Promise<HttpResponse<User>>`; passing `schema` infers `InferSchemaOutput<S>` automatically.
- Request bodies: `string` (`text/plain`), `Uint8Array`/`ArrayBuffer`/`ArrayBufferView` (`application/octet-stream`), `Blob`/`File` (blob's `type`), `FormData` (`multipart/form-data` with boundary), `URLSearchParams` (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), `ReadableStream`/`AsyncIterable`/Node `Readable` (one-shot streamed upload with backpressure; automatic retries disabled), `() => UploadBody | Promise<UploadBody>` factory (replayed on retries, body-preserving redirects in Node, and SSE reconnects; opened on admission), or any JSON-serializable value (`application/json`). Explicit `Content-Type` headers are preserved except for `FormData`.
- `responseType`: `'auto'` (default: JSON for `application/json` & `*+json`, string for `text/*`/XML/JS/form, `Uint8Array` otherwise, `null` when empty), `'json'` (strict `JSON.parse`), `'text'`, `'binary'` (`Uint8Array`), `'blob'` (`Blob` with `Content-Type`), `'stream'` (`ReadableStream<Uint8Array>`), `'ndjson'` (`ReadableStream` of parsed JSON lines).
- `HttpResponse<T>`: `{ status, statusText, ok, url, headers, body, cached?, revalidated?, resumes?, timings? }`. `headers` keys are lower-cased with repeated values joined by `, `. `ok` is `true` for 2xx and `false` for redirects returned under `redirect: 'manual'`.
- `redirect`: `'follow'` (default, up to `maxRedirects`, default `20`), `'manual'` (resolves with redirect response + `location` header; browsers return opaque `status: 0` with no headers/body and apply their own redirect limit), `'error'` (rejects with `NetworkError`).
- Browser `fetch()` options (`BrowserRequestOptions`, settable on client or per request; validated in Node and ignored): `credentials` (`'same-origin' | 'include' | 'omit'`), `mode` (`'cors' | 'same-origin' | 'no-cors'`), `cache` (`'default' | 'no-store' | 'reload' | 'no-cache' | 'force-cache' | 'only-if-cached'`), `keepalive`, `priority` (`'high' | 'low' | 'auto'`), `referrer`, `referrerPolicy`, `integrity`.

## Timeouts, retries, idempotency, and cancellation

- **Timeouts** (client, request, and `events()`; omitted/`null`/`undefined` inherit client setting, `0` disables that timer independently):
  - `timeoutMs` (default `30000` ms): per attempt, including response body; for `responseType: 'stream'`, `'ndjson'`, `events()`, and `websocket()` covers wait until headers/open.
  - `connectTimeoutMs`: connection + DNS/TLS establishment on Node/native; browsers ignore unobservable connect timing.
  - `responseTimeoutMs`: admitted attempt until final response headers arrive (including redirects).
  - `idleTimeoutMs`: max wait between incoming response/SSE chunks (buffered, streamed, `'ndjson'`, `events()`), or max silence after open/between messages on `websocket()` (no heartbeats sent; inherits client `idleTimeoutMs`).
  - `deadlineMs`: total logical deadline across request interceptors, body prep, queue wait, all attempts/backoff/SSE reconnects, and the full response body; closes even an unread stream at the deadline. Expiring raises `TimeoutError` with `phase` (`'connect' | 'response' | 'idle' | 'total'`; `timeoutMs` and `deadlineMs` use `'total'`).
- **Retries** (`retries`: count or `RetryOptions`, off by default; per-request object replaces client policy cleanly, using standard defaults for omitted fields; `0` disables):
  - Defaults: `maxRetries: 3`, `initialDelayMs: 100`, `maxDelayMs: 10_000`, `multiplier: 2`, `retryOn: [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504]`, `retryOnNetworkError: true`, `retryOnTimeout: true`, `retryNonIdempotent: false`.
  - Backoff grows as `initialDelayMs * multiplier^(attempt - 1)`, capped at `maxDelayMs`, with each delay randomized to **50–100% jitter**; `Retry-After` (seconds) is honoured up to `maxDelayMs`. POST/PATCH are not retried unless `retryNonIdempotent: true` or an `idempotencyKey` is active. `InvalidInputError`, `ParseError`, `ValidationError`, `CircuitOpenError`, and unlisted statuses are never retried.
  - `retryBudget: true | { ratio: 0.2, minPerSecond: 10, windowMs: 10_000 }`: client-wide sliding budget for retries; exhausted budget rejects immediately with the last attempt's error + `retryBudgetExhausted: true` and increments `client.retriesRefused`.
- **Idempotency keys** (client, request, `events()`): `idempotencyKey: true` (UUID per logical call via `crypto.randomUUID()`, reused across retries/SSE reconnects), explicit ASCII string, or `false` to opt out; `idempotencyHeader` defaults to `'Idempotency-Key'`. Requires server-side deduplication; allows POST/PATCH retries under the active retry policy without bypassing budgets or limits.
- **Cancellation** (`signal: AbortSignal`): cancels queued waits, active attempts, pending retry delays, unread/active streams, `events()`, and `websocket()`. Rejects with `CancelledError` carrying `error.reason` and `error.cause` (e.g. `DOMException` `TimeoutError` from `AbortSignal.timeout()`).

## Limits, circuit breakers, caching, auth, schema, pagination, and derived clients

- Load limits: `maxConcurrent` (streams/SSE hold slots until EOF/cancel), `rateLimit: { requests, perMs }` (token bucket refilled continuously, FIFO admission in Rust, paused on `429 Retry-After`; queue waits cancel without spending tokens), `limitsPerOrigin: true` (isolates limits per origin; default `false`), `maxPendingRequests` (sheds excess started/unfinished requests immediately across all transports with `NetworkError.maxPendingRequests`).
- Circuit breaker (client, opt-in): `circuitBreaker: { failureThreshold: 5, resetAfterMs: 30_000 }`, `onCircuitChange({ origin, from, to })`. Per origin (`'closed' | 'open' | 'half-open'`); failed network/timeout/5xx attempts open it; one probe runs after `resetAfterMs`. Open calls fail fast with `CircuitOpenError` (`origin`, `retryAfterMs`, not retried).
- `schema`: any [Standard Schema](https://standardschema.dev) validator (Zod, Valibot, ArkType; zero dependencies). Invalid response bodies reject with `ValidationError` (`issues`, `status`, never retried). Not supported with `responseType: 'stream'` or `'ndjson'`.
- `auth` (client option): `{ bearer: token | (() => token | undefined | Promise<token | undefined>), refresh?: () => void | Promise<void>, origins?: string[] }` or `{ basic: { username, password } }`. Sent only to `baseUrl` origin and `auth.origins` (one is required); explicit per-request `Authorization` wins. With `refresh`, concurrent `401` responses trigger one single-flight refresh and replay buffered requests once (streamed bodies are not replayed). Applies to HTTP requests and `events()`.
- `client.extend(overrides?)`: returns a derived client with case-insensitive merged `headers`, replaced non-header options, and cloned initial interceptors; circuit breakers, rate limits, concurrency limits, retry budgets, and metrics are isolated from the parent.
- `client.paginate(url, { items?, next?, maxPages = 1000, crossOrigin = false, signal, ...requestOptions })`: `AsyncGenerator` yielding pages (or mapped `items`). Follows `Link` `rel="next"` by default or custom `next(response)`. Cross-origin `next` URLs throw `InvalidInputError` unless `crossOrigin: true`.
- `dedupe: true` (client or per `get`/`head`): deduplicates identical in-flight requests (URL, headers, options) and gives each caller its own response copy; cancelling one caller leaves others running. Skips writes, streamed responses, and callbacks.
- `httpCache: true | { maxEntries = 100, maxBytes = 50_000_000, maxEntryBytes = 1_000_000 }`: private in-memory RFC 9111 cache for `GET` (`response.cached`, `response.revalidated` on `304`, honours `no-store`/`no-cache`/`Vary`, invalidated by successful writes); pass `httpCache: false` per request to bypass.
- `resume: true | { maxResumes = 3 }` on streamed `get`: resumes broken downloads with `Range`/`If-Range` when server sent `200`, `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, strong `ETag` or `Last-Modified`, and no `Content-Encoding` (`response.resumes` counts continuations; rejects if server changes content instead of `206`).

## Errors and type guards

Every failure rejects with a `RustFetchError` carrying `kind` and `name`, plus common metadata (`method`, `url`, `attempts`, `cause`, `timings`, `retryBudgetExhausted`):
- `HttpError`: non-2xx; has `status`, `statusText`, `body` (text)
- `TimeoutError`: has `timeoutMs`, `phase` (`'connect' | 'response' | 'idle' | 'total'`)
- `CircuitOpenError`: has `origin`, `retryAfterMs`
- `NetworkError`: DNS, connection, TLS, CORS, SSRF block, disallowed redirect scheme, truncated body, or limit exceeded (`maxResponseBytes`, `maxPendingRequests`, `maxLineBytes`, `maxEventBytes`, `maxQueuedMessages`, `maxQueuedBytes`)
- `CancelledError`: aborted `signal`; has `reason` and `cause`
- `InvalidInputError`: invalid URL, header, option, or body before sending; has `parameter`
- `ParseError`: invalid JSON (including `ndjson`/`events()`/`websocket()` with `messageType: 'json'`) or non-`text/event-stream` SSE response
- `ValidationError`: `schema` mismatch; has `issues`, `status`; never retried
- `JsInteropError`: unexpected JS/Wasm boundary conversion failure

Type guards check error shape across realms/copies and narrow in TypeScript (`RustFetchErrorOf<K>`, `RustFetchHttpError`, etc.): `isRustFetchError(value, kind?)`, `isHttpError`, `isTimeoutError`, `isNetworkError`, `isParseError`, `isInvalidInputError`, `isCancelledError`, `isCircuitOpenError`, `isValidationError`, `isJsInteropError`.

## Observability, tracing, and metrics

- `timings: true`: attaches `timings: { queuedMs, retryDelayMs, totalMs, attempts }` to `HttpResponse` and `RustFetchError`. Each attempt includes `startMs`, `ttfbMs` (`null` when unavailable), `totalMs`, `status`, `error`, `transport`, `connectMs`, `tlsMs`, `connectionReused`.
- `metrics: true` or `client.stats()`: returns detached `ClientStats` (`requests`, `attempts`, `retries`, `latency` with `minMs`/`maxMs`/`meanMs`/`p50Ms`/`p95Ms`/`p99Ms` over up to 1,024 samples, bounded `origins`, and shared Node `pools` (`{ queued, native, http }` or `null` in browsers)).
- Hooks & logs: `onRequestStart(entry)`, `onRequestEnd(entry)`, `debug: true | ((entry) => void)` (`DEBUG=rust-fetch` in Node; explicit `debug: false` overrides), and synchronous `redactUrl(url)`. Diagnostic hooks/logs strip query strings, fragments, and URL credentials (`error.url` masks passwords as `***` and drops fragments across the `cause` chain), and redact `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Set-Cookie`, and `sensitiveHeaders` to `[REDACTED]`.
- W3C Trace Context: disabled by default; requires `propagateTrace: true`, exact origin allowlist `traceOrigins`, and synchronous `traceContext: () => ({ traceparent, tracestate? })`. Stripped on cross-origin Node redirects; browser tracing refuses redirects.

## Security defaults and Node.js transports

- **Header/URL/SSRF safety:** Rejects CR/LF header injection; rejects non-`http(s)` redirects; drops `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Proxy-Authorization`, and `sensitiveHeaders` on cross-origin Node redirects; `allowInsecureRedirects: false` blocks `https:` → `http:` redirects (Node); `allowAbsoluteUrls: false` enforces `baseUrl` isolation; `allowPrivateNetwork: false` (Node, per client/request/`websocket()`) blocks loopback, private, link-local, metadata (`169.254.169.254`), CGNAT, and reserved IPv6 ranges at DNS resolve time and across redirects/reconnects. `maxResponseBytes`, `maxLineBytes`, and `maxEventBytes` reject oversized bodies/lines/events before expanding (`null` per request/stream disables client limit). JS wrappers guard against `Object.prototype` pollution.
- **Node.js transports & TLS:** Uses `node:http`/`node:https` with a 256-socket-per-origin LIFO keep-alive pool (5 s idle timeout, 1,024-slot in-flight queue), or optional `rust-fetch-native` addon when built (`npm run build:native`; disabled by `RUST_FETCH_NATIVE=0`, custom global agents, `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY`, or per-request `onUploadProgress`, download progress, streaming responses, `events()`, `proxy`, `allowPrivateNetwork: false`). Both require SubjectAltName (no CN fallback) and OpenSSL `@SECLEVEL=2`; respects `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` (with Node warning), and `proxy: 'env' | url` (`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`). On Node 20–23, import applies V8 `--no-turbo-inline-js-wasm-calls` to avoid a V8 Wasm cancellation crash (or pass it explicitly at Node launch).

## Streaming, Server-Sent Events, uploads, and WebSockets

- **Streaming & download progress:** `responseType: 'stream'` and `'ndjson'` resolve at headers; read via `res.body.getReader()` or `for await` (cancel unused streams so sockets close promptly). `onDownloadProgress({ loaded, total })` works on buffered and `'blob'` responses too (`total` is `null` if unknown).
- **Upload progress (`onUploadProgress({ loaded, total })`):** In browsers, buffered uploads use `XMLHttpRequest` (cross-origin preflighted; falls back to single completion callback over `fetch()` in service workers or with `responseTimeoutMs`/`idleTimeoutMs`). In Node.js, runs via `node:http` in 64 KB chunks. `total` is `0` for unknown-length streaming bodies; buffered uploads cannot combine `onUploadProgress` with `responseType: 'stream'`.
- **Interceptors:** `addRequestInterceptor(fn)`, `addResponseInterceptor(onFulfilled?, onRejected?)`, `ejectInterceptor(id)`, `clearInterceptors()` (`auth` interceptor stays across `clearInterceptors()`).
- **SSE (`client.events(url, options?)`):** Any method/headers/body; `{ event, data, id }`; `messageType: 'auto' | 'json'` (`end` defaults to `'[DONE]'` with `'json'`); reconnects with `Last-Event-ID` & server `retry:` (`reconnect` defaults `true` for GET, `false` otherwise); 64-event async-iterator backpressure buffer or `onEvent`; exposes `state`, `url`, `lastEventId`, `opened`, `closed`, `close()`, `next()`, `return()`, `[Symbol.asyncIterator]()`.
- **WebSockets (`client.websocket(url, options?)`):** Works in browsers and Node.js 22+ (Node 20 with `--experimental-websocket`); `http:`/`https:` resolve to `ws:`/`wss:`; supports `idleTimeoutMs`, `protocols`, `params`, Node-only `headers` & undici `dispatcher` (e.g. `ProxyAgent`), `timeoutMs`, `reconnect` (`maxRetries`, `initialDelayMs: 1000`, `maxDelayMs: 30000`, `multiplier: 2`, jittered; reconnects on failed attempts and codes 1001, 1006, 1011–1014), `allowAbsoluteUrls`, `allowPrivateNetwork`, `maxQueuedMessages`, `maxQueuedBytes`, `signal`, `messageType: 'auto' | 'json'`, lifecycle callbacks, `send()`, `sendJson()`, `close(code?, reason?)` (`1000` or `3000-4999`, `<= 123` UTF-8 bytes), `bufferedAmount`, `protocol`, `state`, `url`, `opened`, `closed`. Chat recipes: `examples/websocket-chat/{request.mjs,channels.mjs}`.

## Testing, runtimes, bundlers, and Rust crate

- **Mock transport:** `import { createMockTransport } from 'rust-fetch/testing'` gives `mock.on(method, pathOrRegExpOrFn, handler)`, `.onAny(handler)`, `.calls`, `.reset()`.
- **Verified environments:** Node.js 20/22/24 (Linux, macOS, Windows), Chromium, Firefox (no HTTP/2 duplex streaming upload support), WebKit, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers (`workerd`; import the `.wasm` as a module and pass it to `await init({ module_or_path })`), plus Vite 8, webpack 5, and esbuild (copy `.wasm` beside bundle). Vercel Edge and deployed Workers are not tested. Runnable examples: `examples/{node-client,llm-streaming,websocket-chat,browser-upload,cloudflare-worker}`.
- **Rust crate (`rust-fetch`):** Exports `Client`, `ClientBuilder`, `RequestBuilder` (`on_upload_progress` on native targets), `StreamingResponse`, `RetryConfig`, `RetryBudget`, `RateLimit`, `CircuitBreaker`, `CircuitChange`, `CircuitOpenError`, `CircuitState`, `PhaseTimeouts`, `TimeoutDetails`, `TimeoutPhase`, `Progress`, `Multipart`, `Headers`, `Method`, `Redirect`, `Response`, `ResponseBody`, `Error`, `Result`, and `prelude`. Not included in the Rust crate: JS interceptors and WebSockets.
